Commands_Blurb: Everything the server can be told to do. Each one runs exactly what you would type on the console, so the result appears there.
Commands_Kick: Disconnect a player and keep them out for a while.
Commands_Mute: Stop a player speaking for a while.
Commands_Ban: Ban a player's account for good.
Commands_RefreshBanList: Reload the ban list from disk.
Commands_Motd: Set the message of the day.
Commands_Respawn: Reset one map's items and NPCs.
Commands_MapReport: List the map numbers nobody has authored yet.
Commands_AdvanceWar: Push war night into its next phase.
Console_StoppingNotice: Asked the server to shut down. It saves everything still in memory before it exits, so give it up to {Seconds} seconds.
Config_DeathPenaltyBlurb: What a player loses when they die. Each part is independent, and players under level 10 are spared either way.
Config_DurabilityLossHint: Worn equipment loses durability, and a caster loses reagents to match. Rain doubles it; a guild war doubles it again.
Config_ItemDropHint: Part of the bag falls on the ground. A player flagged for PK drops all of it, plus a chance at each worn piece.
Config_ExpLossHint: Death costs experience, and enough of it costs levels. Turning this off also means a PvP kill pays nothing, since that reward is taken from the victim.
Config_LanguageBlurb: The language this window, the server console and the log files use. Players are not affected: each one sees the game in the language they chose.
Config_LanguageServerNote: This window changes straight away. The server console follows the next time it starts.
Config_RestartRequired: Changes apply the next time the server starts.
